candidates.classification: Conditional source-derived exact-volume comparison error for a hypothetical larger supported-capacity cooking vessel, extending earlier broad open volume and provenance questions without asserting a historical unique finding.
candidates.trace: The exact collection path records requested whole milliliters as checked integer microliters. contained_water_contamination converts the public whole-milliliter holding exactly and, for a full preview, proportional_material_transfer returns each selected contribution unchanged. In cooking, the same public whole milliliters are first cast to f32 and multiplied by 1000 in Microliters::try_from_nonnegative_milliliters_rounded; the exact contribution sum is then compared against that rounded public amount. A downward rounding can make equal volumes appear unequal and trigger the material-exceeds-public-volume error before the code deletes container water.
candidates.source_derived_example: Hypothesize one valid water contribution of 134221 ml and an equal public holding. The exact amount is 134221000 microliters. Under ordinary IEEE-754 binary32 rounding, 134221 is exactly representable, but multiplying by 1000 rounds the f32 value down to 134220992. The exact 134221000 contribution then exceeds the rounded public value by 8 microliters. This describes arithmetic and the selected branches, not an executed collection or cooking action.
candidates.producers_and_consumers: The collection reducer requires a living actor, generated active capability, exact presence, carried custody, compatible liquid, available source and checked capacity; it stores checked integer contribution units. The generated dysentery contaminated-well source is initialized with 500000 ml, but this does not prove the example collection, ingredient placement or cooking chronology. method_for_instrument permits the named pan, pot and portable oven. The item container capacity field validator accepts 1 through 1000000 ml, so a hypothetical cooking_pot with 200000 ml passes that one field check, leaving room for water and food in principle; no claim is made that such edited content or a resulting game state is fully valid or reachable.
candidates.safeguards_and_limits: Read-only parsing of the pinned catalogue finds cooking_pan 2500 ml, cooking_pot 8000 ml and portable_oven 12000 ml. Every whole milliliter amount up to 12000 and its product by 1000 are exactly representable as binary32, so the demonstrated rounding mismatch is not produced by a capacity-respecting holding in these currently authored vessels. Other container writers, malformed state, catalogue cross-validation, target-specific floating behavior, chronology and supported larger vessels remain unassessed. A larger public amount can round upward as well; this record claims only the demonstrated downward comparison.
